item.behavior: 原多序列LineChart、汇总数值和收益明细表组合，移动端与桌面端原响应式展示；数据为固定数组。
item.difference: 不同于单独chart primitive或表格换皮：保留原趋势+多维资金明细组合报告，不按序列/断点拆项。
gaps: 原onValueChange为空回调，不能宣称图表选点联动下表；不是实时行情/投资建议/交易。LineChart底层Recharts等导入链、媒体/字体/CSP/资源与传递许可未完整审查。
完整运行依赖/图标/素材许可未闭合；只收录固定原源码，不含完整可运行归档。未构建、未运行、未测默认CSP/退出清理、未做浏览器视觉验收。
item.description: 原多序列LineChart、汇总数值和收益明细表组合，移动端与桌面端原响应式展示；数据为固定数组。 不同于单独chart primitive或表格换皮：保留原趋势+多维资金明细组合报告，不按序列/断点拆项。

licenseEvidence.scope: Full root MIT read; transitive runtime/media permissions not closed

item.sourceScope: Selected fixed original code and complete root license evidence; no complete runnable/archive or runtime audit
item.buildStatus: fixed original source and complete root license read; not built, run or visually accepted

knownGaps: Browser pixels/responsive layout not visually verified; desktop and mobile nodes coexist in JSDOM, not proof both rendered layouts are visually correct.
All 57 daily records, totals, financial names and static table are upstream fixtures, not real-time market data or investment advice.
Original onValueChange is a no-op; legend selection emphasizes curves but never filters/recalculates table.
Original enableLegendSlider remains false. Supplemental non-public test scene tests the same LineChart slider cleanup; it is not a claimed visible feature.
Unretrieved JetBrains font face removed; system fallback. Recharts 2.15.0 is upstream-era deprecated version retained, not upgraded to incompatible v3.
